picks.title: Nuclear startup Valar Atomics in talks to raise new funding at $6B valuation
picks.why_it_matters: Signals continued strong investor appetite for deep tech/climate infrastructure plays, and the trend toward complex deal structures that early-stage VCs should understand when negotiating terms with founders eyeing similar trajectories.

picks.title: China just erased America's AI lead
picks.why_it_matters: A major shift in the AI competitive landscape—Chinese models reaching frontier performance at lower cost reshapes the moat calculus for AI startups and may accelerate opportunities in AI applications over pure model plays.

picks.title: No product? No problem. This Disrupt 2026 session shows how to get pre-seed funding with conviction, storytelling
picks.why_it_matters: Confirms that AI-driven seed competition is squeezing non-AI pre-seed founders, which may create valuation opportunities for VCs willing to back strong teams in overlooked verticals.
